    • supervisor

      public AgentAttributes.Builder supervisor(Boolean supervisor)
      Sets whether the agent is a supervisor at creation time. The database does not allow changing this flag after creation. Assign the created supervisor to a team using TeamAttributes.Builder.supervisorAgent(String); do not include it in that team's worker agent-task mappings.

      For a runnable example, see SupervisorTeamSample source.

      Parameters:
      supervisor - whether the agent supervises other agents
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public AgentAttributes build()
      Builds agent attributes without validating required database fields. Required-field and semantic validation is performed by DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT when the agent is created.
      Returns:
      immutable agent attributes
